Date-bound

Sales follow the calendar

A live workshop has a date. Someone who finds you the day after it ends has to wait, or find her own way through your link in bio.

No evergreen entry

Nothing built to scale daily

There’s no small, self-paced offer designed to take new buyers every single day, so growth rides on how far each post travels.

No qualifying step

1:1 clients look like everyone else

Workshop and course buyers are never asked if they want deeper support, so the women ready for 1:1 stay invisible until they message you.

The women who aren’t ready for 1:1 today only have something to buy around workshop days, and the ones who are ready look the same as everyone else until they reach out.

Sound familiar?

You plan every week as if it should feel the same

  • Some weeks you’re full of ideas and energy. Other weeks you want to slow right down, and nobody ever explained why.
  • You plan your week as if every day should feel the same, then feel behind when it doesn’t.
  • You grew up learning to keep your cycle quiet, private and a little embarrassing.
  • You want to lead your love life, your work and your days from self-trust instead of pushing through.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five short lessons, at your own pace

Letting go of the shame

Where the silence around our cycles comes from, and how to start talking about yours with curiosity instead.

Your month as a rhythm

A simple, educational overview of the phases of the month, and how to notice your own patterns in the journal.

Planning work and energy with your phases

When to start things, when to finish them and when to rest, mapped onto your phase planner.

Love and asking for what you need

How to talk to the people closest to you about what you need across the month, without apologising for it.

Self-leadership: your monthly review

Questions

Before you start

Is this medical advice?

No. The kit is educational coaching content about awareness, planning and self-leadership. It doesn’t diagnose or treat anything and isn’t a replacement for your doctor.

Do I need to be tracking my cycle already?

No. The journal walks you through noticing your own patterns from day one.

How is this different from the live workshop?

The live workshop runs with Kersten on set dates. The kit is self-paced and ready whenever you are, and it pairs well with the next live workshop.

Why only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Start here, and if you want more support, there’s a way to work with Kersten 1:1 afterwards.

Educational content, not medical advice.

Script 1 · “The same-every-day myth”

Hook (0 to 3s)

Kersten: “Here’s a planning habit most women were never taught.”

Body

“We plan every week as if each day should feel the same. In my coaching we plan with the month instead: when to start things, when to finish them, when to rest, and when to have the big conversations.”

CTA

“I put the basics into a self-paced kit. Five short lessons, a journal and a planner. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: Kersten talking to camera. On-screen text: “PCC coach Kersten Kloser-Pitcher on planning with your month”. Caption ends with “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “The quiet topic”

Hook (0 to 3s)

Kersten: “So many of us learned to keep our cycle quiet.”

Body

“I’ve coached hundreds of women on love, life and self-leadership, and so often nobody ever talked about it growing up, so they learned to push through. Working with your cycle starts with dropping the shame around it.”

CTA

“That’s lesson one of my Cycle Self-Leadership Kit. Self-paced, $27, start this week. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: Kersten in natural light, close framing. On-screen text: “Work with your cycle without shame”.

Script 3 · “The monthly review”

Hook (0 to 3s)

Kersten: “Try this once a month. It takes five minutes.”

Body

“Look back at your month. When did you have the most energy? When did you need rest? When did the hard conversations feel easier? That’s the monthly review in my kit, and it’s where self-leadership starts.”
